items.item_text: UCLA Catering is seeking a dependable and customer-service-driven Banquet Server to deliver exceptional dining experiences across campus and off-site locations. In this role, you will handle the end-to-end logistics of catered events—from gathering and loading equipment to setting up venues, serving guests, and breaking down event sites.
Ability to sufficiently communicate in written and verbal English to receive work assignments and share information with supervisors and colleagues
Working knowledge of basic culinary techniques, terminology, and practices

Skill in interacting effectively with guests, team members, and managers in a high-volume, public setting using positive body language, direct eye contact, active listening, and friendly and professional demeanor
Working knowledge of alcoholic beverages, including beer, wine, and spirits
Ability to work cooperatively as a part of a team
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment with a fluctuating workload
Ability to read, write, and perform basic calculations necessary to understand recipes, measurements, and portion sizes
Ability to comply with safety and sanitation standards and procedures for food storage, production, and service
Ability to engage with diverse populations in a respectful and culturally responsive manner
Ability to remain calm in the face of adversity, such as customer dissatisfaction
Demonstrated ability to prepare beverages and complete single-step food preparation tasks such as slicing bread and arranging food items on a buffet table
Ability to maintain regular, punctual attendance
